name: Moog One
source: Moog Music, 'Moog One Manual Addendum: MIDI Learn' (firmware 1.1.0, Aug 2019) -- MIDI CONTROL OUTPUT (CC / MIDI MAP / NRPN), ALWAYS SEND NRPN NUM, LEARN MIDI CC (7/14-bit) and the complete NRPN table (Synth 1/2/3 numbers + value bands); shipped in the firmware zip https://cdn.inmusicbrands.com/Moog/MoogOne/Moog_One_v1.8.2.zip ('Past Firmware Update Release Notes/Moog One Midi Learn Addendum.pdf', also https://api.moogmusic.com/sites/default/files/2019-08/Moog_One_Addendum-Midi-Learn.pdf). Moog One Manual 8/2/19 (https://cdn.inmusicbrands.com/Moog/MoogOne/Moog_One_Manual_8_2_19.pdf) pp.127-130 MIDI CONTROL / MIDI I/O (per-synth channels, IN/OUT ports, LOAD FROM PRESET), p.57 Performance Sets, parameter ranges pp.22-60. Release notes v1.0.1-v1.8.2 in the same zip (1.1.0: NRPN for all analog panel params, LEARN MIDI CC, Program Change + Bank Change; 1.2.0: MIDI map save/load; 1.8.0: sync rates / EG sync / glide made MIDI-mappable, slope + SVF mode now reflected on the panel). Cross-checked number-for-number against the pencilresearch/midi dataset (midi.guide/d/moog/one, Moog/One.csv, 356 rows -- identical).

timbres.label: synth
timbres.note: Tri-timbral: every NRPN number already names its synth (Synth 2 = Synth 1 + 3840, Synth 3 = Synth 1 + 7680), so all three are editable on one MIDI channel.

driverNotes: NEW transport 'moog' (shared with devices/muse.json; no driver yet -- add to drivers.js TRANSPORTS/makeDriver). For the Moog One it is the existing nrpnDriver minus every SysEx path, plus value bands. (1) SEND (sendParam): wire = p.wire ? p.wire[v - p.min] : v (0-16383); midi.nrpn(ch, p.nrpn, wire) exactly as today: CC99 = nrpn >> 7 (= p.nrpnMsb), CC98 = nrpn & 127, CC6 = wire >> 7, CC38 = wire & 127. All values are 14-bit (0-16383); enum params (octave, waveforms, switches, sync divisions, filter modes) are value BANDS -- p.wire holds the lower bound of each option's band, which is always inside the band. Channel = the editor channel for every param (synth 1-3 is encoded in the NRPN number; requires MIDI IN ROUTE = ALL SYNTHS -- see setup/uncertain). (2) DECODE (decode ev): ev.type === 'nrpn' on the editor channel -> p = byNrpn.get(ev.param); value = p.wire ? (last index i with p.wire[i] <= ev.value) : ev.value. The One transmits this when MIDI CONTROL OUTPUT = NRPN; with ALWAYS SEND NRPN NUM = OFF it sends only CC6/CC38 for repeat moves of the same param (running NRPN) -- midi.js receiveCC already keeps pMsb/pLsb between flushes, so both work; ON is recommended. (3) sendPatch(values): no SysEx exists -> NRPN burst of every param with a value (354 synth params x 4 CCs x 3 bytes ~ 4.2 KB; ~1.4 s on DIN at 31250 baud plus gapMs, near-instant on USB). Skip notInPatch params (master/headphone volume). (4) requestPatch / requestProgram / writeProgram / requestSlotName: not possible -- throw 'Moog One has no MIDI patch dump (save on the synth; back up via LIBRARY > EXPORT to a USB drive)'. The editor's values are therefore only what it has sent or heard since connecting; mark everything unknown until touched or sent. (5) programChange(bi, prog): PC prog (0-63) on the editor channel with no bank select (selectProgram with a bank that has no msb/lsb). (6) probe(): nothing documented answers a request (no Device Inquiry reply documented). Return true when the output port is open, or report 'heard' once any NRPN/CC arrives from the input. (7) sameProgram: n/a (no reads). (8) Not reachable over MIDI at all: effects (synth FX + master FX, Eventide reverbs), arpeggiator, sequencer, mod matrix, glide, LFO sync/reset switches, EG delay/hold/velocity, key tracking, SVF spacing, polyphony voice count, output mixer, performance-set structure. Moog's own LEARN MIDI CC only covers 'analog parameters controlled by the front panel' too.

capabilities.sendWholePatch: NRPN burst of the 354 mapped synth params (no SysEx)
capabilities.note: Send-only + panel-follow. followsPanel needs MIDI CONTROL OUTPUT = NRPN and covers only the 354 synth params below (118 per synth); the editor never learns the rest of a preset. Presets are saved on the synth (SAVE); backup is file-based: SETTINGS > LIBRARY > EXPORT to a FAT32 USB stick writes .m1p files (plain text, OSC-style '/p/...' key-value lines) -- a possible future import/export path, not MIDI.

setup: Firmware: SETTINGS > UTILITIES > FIRMWARE VERSION. Needs 1.1.0+ (NRPN + program change arrived in 1.1.0); use 1.8.2 (Sep 2025) -- 1.8.0 fixed Windows USB-MIDI, crashes under heavy MIDI, and made LFO/EG sync rates MIDI-mappable.
SETTINGS > GLOBAL > MIDI CONTROL > MIDI CONTROL OUTPUT = NRPN (panel moves then send NRPN so the editor follows the panel).
Same page: ALWAYS SEND NRPN NUM = ON.
SETTINGS > GLOBAL > MIDI I/O: LOAD FROM PRESET = OFF (so loading a preset cannot change the routing below).
MIDI IN ROUTE = ALL SYNTHS and MIDI IN CHANNEL ALL = the editor channel.
MIDI OUT ROUTE = ALL SYNTHS and MIDI OUT CHANNEL ALL = the editor channel.
MIDI IN PORTS / MIDI OUT PORTS = USB (or DIN, or DIN & USB) -- whichever cable you use; USB-B needs no driver on macOS.
Program changes pick a slot of the current Performance Set: build the set (BANK A-H x PRESET 1-8) on the synth first.
Cable both ways (USB does both). Nothing to enable for receive: 'The NRPN input always works and is never overridden.'

banks.label: set
banks.note: PC 0-63 = the 64 slots (BANK A-H x PRESET 1-8) of the CURRENT Performance Set (A1 = PC 0 ... H8 = PC 63). No names can be read, so the editor can't list what is in each slot; no dump, no store.

programs.note: Program Change + Bank Change 'supported' since 1.1.0; the bank-select mapping (which set or bank CC0/CC32 picks) is not documented -- see uncertain. Bank select is deliberately not sent.

uncertain: Program change: the addendum/manual only say Program Change and Bank Change are supported (1.1.0) and that Performance Sets 'facilitate remote MIDI Program and Bank selection'. The 0-63 = A1..H8-of-current-set mapping comes from user reports (gigmeister device list: '8 banks x 8 presets = 64 programs'; gearspace owners thread: bank select works but the bank LED may not update). What CC0/CC32 selects (performance set number?) is undocumented.
Channel rules for NRPN receive when MIDI IN ROUTE = PER SYNTH are not documented (is an NRPN obeyed on any synth's channel, or only the matching one?). Setup forces ALL SYNTHS to sidestep it.
NRPN transmit channel with MIDI OUT ROUTE = PER SYNTH: presumably each synth's own out channel; decode ignores channel differences only if the driver listens on all three. Setup forces ALL SYNTHS.

Whether the One transmits CC38 (value LSB) or only CC6 for coarse moves is not stated; midi.js flushes on CC6 after 8 ms without CC38, so either way decodes (a 7-bit-only sender would read as value*128).
Bipolar centres (Osc Frequency/Beat Freq -7..+7, Mod EG / SVF / Ladder EG amounts -10..+10, VCA Pan) assumed at 8192; the table gives only 0-16383.

'SAW' and 'TRIANGLE' rows under each oscillator are read as the WAVE ANGLE stored per wave mode (the manual describes WAVE ANGLE acting on the TRI or SAW generator); the addendum labels them only 'SAW' / 'TRIANGLE'.
Osc 1 has no HARD SYNC NRPN (only Osc 2/3 sync to Osc 1) -- matches the manual.

The addendum is the 1.1.0 list ('a complete list of all current MIDI NRPN'); later firmware (1.2-1.8.2) release notes add CC-mappable targets (glide, sync rates) but publish no new NRPN numbers. The pencilresearch dataset matches the 1.1.0 table exactly.
Rate-synced band values (LFO/EG 13 divisions): the last band is the single value 16383 (1/64 for LFO, 64 for EG) and 15018-16382 is the one before -- taken as printed.

No SysEx is documented at all (the manual's rear-panel page says the MIDI ports can carry 'SysEx', but nothing is specified); no reverse-engineered dump format was found on the Moog forum, gearspace, GitHub, or midi.guide.
Default (CC mode) panel CCs are not published beyond CC1 mod wheel, CC64 sustain, CC66 sostenuto, CC75/76/77 X/Y pad + pressure; so the schema carries no 'cc' fields.
